function diegoPrice(pax){if(pax<=0)return 0;return 25+Math.max(0,pax-3)*10}
function calcBase(kiteAdults,sansAdults,nights){var total=kiteAdults+sansAdults;if(total===0)return{lines:[],cost:0,estimate:!1};if(total===1){if(kiteAdults===1){var c=rate(RATES.soloKite,nights);return{lines:[{label:'1 personne kitesurf',cost:c}],cost:c,estimate:!1}}

if(remSans>0){var cs=remSans*rate(RATES.extraSans,nights);lines.push({label:'Adulte(s) suppl. sans kitesurf ×'+remSans,cost:cs});cost+=cs}
return{lines:lines,cost:cost,estimate:estimate}}
